name: label-image-mcp
description: Manage images and annotations in the Image Label app, and export COCO or YOLO datasets.
long_description: Lets Claude list, upload and describe images saved in Image Label (labels.sachin-kale.com), add or clean up annotations, and export COCO or YOLO training data. Needs an Image Label account to upload or save annotations.

username.title: Username
username.description: Image Label account username. Leave empty for read-only access.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Only change this to use a different deployment

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List saved images, optionally filtered by category

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get an image's metadata, annotations and viewing URL

tools.name: update_image_metadata
tools.description: Update an image's name, category or description

tools.name: replace_annotations
tools.description: Replace all annotations on an image

tools.name: export_annotations
tools.description: Export annotations as COCO JSON or YOLO
